component.name: ProbeItem
component.script:
' Registers itself in m.global.probeNodes on its first content; reports every later content change. sub onContent() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.top.findNode("title").text = c.title m.top.findNode("fill").color = c.hdPosterUrl if m.serial = invalid m.serial = m.global.serial + 1 m.global.serial = m.serial m.top.id = "item" + m.serial.toStr() nodes = m.global.probeNodes nodes.push(m.top) m.global.probeNodes = nodes end if print "PROBE|---|content|" + m.top.id + "|title=" + c.title + " rowIndex=" + m.top.rowIndex.toStr() + " index=" + m.top.index.toStr() end sub
sub onSize() fill = m.top.findNode("fill") fill.width = m.top.width fill.height = m.top.height title = m.top.findNode("title") title.width = m.top.width title.height = m.top.height end sub
